title: 16-Year-Old Drowns at Genoa Quarry
text:
Trending Story
Updated 04:25 AM UTC, Thu June 26, 2025
16-Year-Old Drowns at Genoa Quarry
GENOA, Ohio — An out-of-state 16-year-old boy apparently drowned Wednesday in Genoa Quarry at Veterans Park in Ottawa County, fire authorities said. The official cause of death is pending an autopsy, said Capt. Andy Klinger, Allen-Clay Joint Fire District public information officer. The teen’s name and address were not released by officials. The boy’s family members, who were at the quarry with him, called 911 at 4:07 p.m. to report him missing, Capt. Klinger said. Fire personnel arrived at the scene at 4:11 p.m. and searched the water and the surrounding area. Quarry lifeguards and dive teams from area fire departments also searched the waters. The teen’s body was located at 5:39 p.m., and recovered from the water at 5:42 p.m., he said. “We are incredibly grateful for the partnership and rapid deployment of these dive teams,” Fire Chief Mike Musolf of the Allen-Clay Joint Fire District, said in a statement. “Our thoughts and prayers are with the young man’s family and friends during this heartbreaking time.” The Jerusalem Township Dive Team, the Ottawa County Sheriff’s Office Dive Team, and the Toledo Fire & Rescue Dive Team helped with the search.
